title: Pure tensors for the explicitly transported restriction iso
statement: Fix a prime l, a normalized base comparison family [lem-sf-adic-module-section-data], coefficient ring isomorphisms c on all site objects, and normalized restriction data [lem-sf-adic-slice-restriction]. The explicitly constructed iso adicSliceTensorIso from the restriction of the sectionwise tensor to the tensor of the restricted sectionwise modules preserves every local pure tensor. The iso is defined as the inverse of the path through native tensor pullback, the module restriction iso and the base tensor iso, followed by the tensor iso on the site object and the two factor restriction isos. All data are explicit and no finite-rank or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Sections Localization of ringed sites, Tensor product and Internal Hom; definition-localize-ringed-site, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, lemma-internal-hom-restriction and lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor. Specialization and normalization steps of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the native constructions in lean/WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mod/Evaluation.lean and lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/InternalHomEvaluation.lean.

proof.text: Retain the explicit construction adicSliceTensorIso. Its source path d consists of the native balanced tensor pullback iso, the normalized module restriction iso and the restricted base tensor iso. Its target path consists of the base tensor iso on U, the first-factor restriction iso and the sheafified second-factor restriction iso.

Prove nativeTensor_pullSection directly from adicSliceNativeTensorIso_quotient. Naturality of upperStarIsoSheafPushforward with respect to the quotient and its existing monoidal instance identify the quotient composite with the restricted native quotient. Apply tensorObjComparison_naturality to its two factor maps and the existing pushforward comparison formula for the tensor map of sheafToPresheaf. Evaluating the resulting equation on a pure tensor gives the native pullback-section formula, without a localized ringed-site tensor comparison.

For arbitrary sections x,y, lift them through the inverse restriction isos and the additive section equivalences to native pullback sections a,b. Evaluate d on the native pure tensor of a,b using section_map, slice_sections, the preceding native formula and tensor_sections. The result is exactly the original sectionwise pure tensor of x,y. Cancel d followed by its inverse in the defining composite of adicSliceTensorIso. The remaining base tensor map and the two factor maps carry the pure tensor to the pure tensor of x,y on U. The formulas for the factor maps follow by evaluating naturality of the module-sheafification unit. All sections, including zero, are covered.

theorem adicSliceTensorIso_sections (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (base : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, AdicModuleSectionComparison l X)
    (c : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt),
      (base U.left).ring ≅
        (localizationRestriction RingCat.{u + 1} U.hom U.prop).obj (base X).ring)
    (r : AdicSliceRestrictionData l base c)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt) (M N : AdicSheaf l X)
    (V : U.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : ((base X).E.functor.obj M).val.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (f := U.hom) ⊤ U.prop).obj V.unop)))
    (y : ((base X).E.functor.obj N).val.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (f := U.hom) ⊤ U.prop).obj V.unop))) :
    (adicSliceTensorIso l base c r X U M N).hom.val.app V
      (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul (A := (base X).R)
        ((base X).E.functor.obj M) ((base X).E.functor.obj N)
        (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map (f := U.hom) ⊤ U.prop).obj V.unop)) x y) =
      SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul (A := (base U.left).R)
        ((adicComparisonRestriction U (base X) (base U.left) (c X U)).obj
          ((base X).E.functor.obj M))
        ((adicComparisonRestriction U (base X) (base U.left) (c X U)).obj
          ((base X).E.functor.obj N)) V x y
